record_title: Matrix-valued adaptive moments preserve Stiefel equivariance
provenance: Mathematical correction and prior-literature analysis for the O(d)-equivariance uniqueness claim in arXiv:2609.19363v1, with an exact commutant classification and a bi-equivariant covariance-preconditioning construction on the embedded Stiefel manifold.
limitations: The commutant theorem and matrix covariance preconditioning are not claimed new in isolation. The result corrects a source-specific uniqueness argument and prior-work narrative. Matrix-valued adaptation generally changes the embedded-metric steepest direction; no convergence-rate or empirical performance improvement is proved. Exact scale homogeneity is stated only for epsilon zero with positive-definite covariance, and later revisions of the very recent source may change its wording.
